title: If You Abide in My Word, You Are Truly My Disciples
description: This sermon emphasizes the importance of abiding in God's word to truly be His disciples, distinguishing between real and unreal believers. It challenges believers to remain in the truth, beauty, and value of Jesus as revealed in His word, highlighting the necessity of lasting commitment and perseverance. The message addresses believers, unbelievers, and those who may be deceived about their faith, urging all to deeply engage with the life-giving truth found in Jesus.
